plan.headline: 12.7 kg to lose. At 0.5 kg a week that's about 27 weeks.
steps: [ ] Weigh in on three mornings: Same time, before food or drink. One morning is noise; a week of them makes the trend.
[ ] Write one plan for your hardest moment: The weekend, a Friday night, late evenings: decide now what you’ll do then.
[ ] Log one meal — rough is fine: Guess the portion or snap a photo. The app learns from how you log, not from perfect logs.
[ ] Choose how you move: A walk a day counts. Lifting twice a week keeps the muscle while the fat goes.

scaleUp.title: Up 0.6 kg from yesterday
reasons: Normal in the first days: most mornings move up to a kilo either way, from water, salt and what’s still being digested. That’s why Slim Chance waits for a week of mornings before it calls a trend.
